title: Carrier
description: An energy carrier, such as hydrogen, heat, or natural gas. Every flow of a carrier is recorded as energy flow; fuel carriers use the lower heating value. Carrier buses reference a carrier, and conversion links may reference one to label their technology. Emissions from consuming the carrier are recorded by an attached `EmissionsData` with basis `FUEL_INPUT`, on the lower heating value.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type must have unique names, but components of different types can share a name.
